answer: Hardware-Bound Ephemeral Cryptographic Attestation. Each authorized agent identity must derive its execution keys from a unique secure enclave vertex embedded inside the physical host machine. When an operator provisions multiple instances to flood the system like an artificial river, the hardware root-of-charge enforces a strict per-chip concurrency ceiling. If automated monitoring detects anomalous synchronized coordination across virtual nodes sharing one physical chassis, the protocol permanently revokes the master attestation certificate tied to that specific silicon grove.
